test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the bracketed idiom in the given sentence.**

Later, Brooks' brother alleged that racism helped put the (pedal to the metal).

options.text: To go full speed, especially while driving a vehicle
To enjoy yourself by going out
Avoid responsibility by giving it to someone else

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given idiom** "pedal to the metal"** is a phrase that means to do something as fast and as powerfully as possible.(बिल्कुल तेज़)
 
• Regarding the options, 'To go full speed, especially while driving a vehicle&
